flags.text: Partial day: pulled at 09:12 IST, about nine hours into the India day, so these are morning figures and will keep rising.

CRM count is 5: Meta-ad form fills at 00:06, 01:28, 05:01, 06:34 and 08:10 IST, all real people, no tests. Each of the five contacts has only one submission since 31 Oct, so none is a repeat. Meta counts 2 leads so far.
CRM Meta ad data last reported 19 Nov 2026 (get_ad_connection_health). That is yesterday, so the ad-spend sync is current.

Bookings: 0 Appointment Booked records dated 20 Nov. Dr V G Abraham's booking record is dated 19 Nov, but that contact's form came in at 05:01 IST on 20 Nov (23:31 UTC on 19 Nov). CRM booking dates are date-only, so if that record was stamped in UTC it may belong to today; it will be rechecked on the next run.

Campaign table: today's spend (725.57) is the sum of the two ACTIVE campaigns and matches the account pull exactly. The month-to-date campaign total (19,940.59) matches Meta's account month-to-date exactly. MTD list pulled with amount_spent > 0 and no status filter, so paused campaigns that spent this month stay listed.
